title: Black Friday: 50% off Velo Coins & Velo+
summary: From Monday, November 23 until the end of Cyber Monday: every Velo Coin pack and your first month of Velo+ cost half. Biggest deal of the year.

blocks.text: **Black Friday is here.** From **Monday, November 23** until **Cyber Monday (November 30) is over**, everything you buy with real money in Velo costs **half**.

items: **Every Velo Coin pack** - 15,000 coins for **25.00 €** instead of 49.99 €
**Velo+**: your **first month for 5.00 €** instead of 9.99 € (the yearly plan is half price too)
Works in the **launcher**, **in game** and on **velo-client.com/store** - the lower price is already in the checkout, no code needed

blocks.caption: Launcher > Velo Coins: the sale price is right on every pack.

items: Partner codes don't stack with the sale - the sale is the better deal anyway
Coins never expire, so stock up for the **Christmas collection** coming in December
Already have Velo+? Grab coins at half price - your monthly coins keep coming on top

blocks.text: Ends **Monday, November 30 at midnight (CET)**. See you in the Store!
